discussion_comments.comment_body: just noticed this - all the @ pragmas need to be on the first line (also the same fix in other files). I think the reason you're getting errors is that validateRefAccessDuringRender is on by default

```suggestion
import {ErrorCategory} from 'babel-plugin-react-compiler/dist/CompilerError';
```

We should investigate later if we can simplify our import paths (maybe through an alias) for our multi workspace build setup, but for now let's keep the import style consistent
Super nit: we don't need to preserve `showInternals` when resetting the playground. I think this feature as more of a "force reset" which should entirely clear client state
